title: Keep postselected energy errors relative to actual success weights
statement: For H_N=N^-1 sum_i |1><1|_i, A_N=((1/2)|0><0|+|1><1|)^tensor N, q=4^-N and rho=(1-q)|0^N><0^N|+q|1^N><1^N|, input energy q becomes 1/(2-q)>=1/2 after a filter succeeding with probability q(2-q). A fixed rational filter alphabet alone gives no generic stability of conditioned energy. Balanced analyses remain possible; exponentially small success need not imply exponentially many description bits.
